synopsis: ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2023 defines system life-cycle processes and forms part of the backbone of verification and validation planning alongside INCOSE and NASA handbooks [f15346]. Chapter 12 also identifies IEEE 1012 as a source of planning practice, specifying the INCOSE handbook’s fifth edition (2023) and NASA’s SP-2016-6105 Rev 2 [f9537]. The joint designation names the participating standards bodies, including the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) [f15019].

relations.note: Both identify 15288 and INCOSE/NASA handbooks as foundations for verification and validation planning.
